dogecoin.text: @cloudssayhello @dev_jmitchell I suppose, to this question, as I’ve done some reading on blockchain and I do understand its value, why Dogecoin over Bitcoin or Ethereum?  Why does one matter over another?

@cloudssayhello @dev_jmitchell I suppose it relates more to cryptocurrency in general.  But there are places I can go to, a litany of them, that accept Bitcoin today.  Dogecoin, that does not seem to be the case.  If scarcity is not the issue, why does it hold any real value?
